description: Return per-gram gold (XAU) prices by karat purity — 24k, 22k, 21k, 20k, 18k, 16k, 14k, 10k — in a requested currency (default USD; the same 31 currencies get_spot_price serves). Jewelry-grade pricing computed from live XAU spot + ECB FX. FREE on every tier — no plan gate. Values are Decimal-formatted strings, quantized to the currency's ISO 4217 minor unit (JPY → whole numbers, USD → 2dp).
